metadata.dcterms:title: Braid groups and Hodge theory
metadata.dcterms:creator: McMullen, Curtis T.
metadata.dcterms:abstract: This paper gives an account of the unitary representations of the braid group that arise via the Hodge theory of cyclic branched cover- ings of P1, highlighting their connections with ergodic theory, complex reﬂection groups, moduli spaces of 1-forms and open problems in sur- face topology.
